title: Spider-Man: Edge of Time
tagline: Peter Parker and Miguel O’Hara undo the same disaster.
summary: Beenox pairs the Amazing Spider-Man with Spider-Man 2099. Actions in one time period change the other. The antagonist is a scientist’s attempt to rewrite history. This record does not file that plot’s villain under an existing rogue.
gameplay: Switching between Peter and Miguel, with timed rescues across the two periods.
